      "The stated distance is the distance from the pivot to the force application point.",

  "counterexamples": [
    "A force perpendicular to the pivot-to-application-point vector produces 15 N*m.",
    "A force parallel to that vector produces zero torque.",
    "A force at 30 degrees to that vector produces 7.5 N*m."
  ],
  "notes": "The torque of mechanically independent lever system B is structurally disconnected (D) in all four variants. Changing its value leaves the wrench torque relation unchanged. These legacy variants differ only in B's torque value; the missing force direction affects every variant."
